info.name: The Exchange
info.plot: Ambientato in Kuwait nel 1988, due donne si fanno strada nel club dei ragazzi della Borsa del Kuwait, alla vigilia dell'invasione del paese da parte di Saddam Hussein.

seasons.name: Stagione 1
seasons.plot: Inspired by real events, two women set out to pioneer the cutthroat stock market of 1980s Kuwait — and disrupt its corrupt boys club along the way.

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: As the ink dries on her divorce papers, Farida contends with her new reality. A charity auction reignites a friendly rivalry between her and Munira.

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.plot: On their first days at work and school, Farida seeks an alliance and Jude keeps a low profile. Feeling unheard, Munira takes matters into her own hands.

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: As the family meticulously plans for its matriarch's 80th, Munira finds tactical inspiration in an unlikely place. Farida pursues more independence.

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.plot: The duo’s success lands them in the limelight, but the bank’s secret plan finds them between a rock and a hard place — and snubbed by their loved ones.

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.plot: After realizing that their presence in an important meeting is merely for show, Farida and Munira forge their own path — despite external distractions.

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.plot: As the 1987 market crash looms, the Exchange braces for a critical all-nighter. Putting their personal lives on hold, Farida and Munira join the storm.

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: Now officially high-powered career women, Farida and Munira find themselves placed on the contract of a big client with even bigger expectations.

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.plot: Munira buckles under the weight of family duty. Meanwhile, Farida takes matters into her own hands, turning to an unexpected trade partner for help.

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: Between her strained relationship with Jude and relentless ex-husband calling the shots, Farida finds herself in a dramatic, heated argument with Munira.

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.plot: Personal and professional lines are blurred when Munira is presented with a surprise proposal. Farida struggles to adapt to a new family dynamic.

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.plot: I cugini sono affidati un compito cruciale che potrebbe fare loro o distruggerli, mentre Farida sperimenta le crescenti sfide della co-genitorialità.

translations.value: I cugini sono affidati un compito cruciale che potrebbe fare loro o distruggerli, mentre Farida sperimenta le crescenti sfide della co-genitorialità.

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.plot: Il pavimento della borsa valori si scalda mentre l'IPO va in onda. Il duro lavoro di Munira e Farida finalmente salirà all'occorrenza o sprofonderà a nuovi minimi?

translations.title: The Exchange
translations.overview: Set in Kuwait in 1988, two women making their way in the boys club of the Kuwait Stock Exchange, on the eve of Saddam Hussein's invasion of the country.

translations.title: الصفقة
translations.overview: تدخل امرأتان رائدتان معترك البورصة الكويتية التنافسية في ثمانينيات القرن الماضي وتزعزعان بيئة العمل التي يديرها الرجال. من وحي أحداث حقيقية.
